title: Buffalo
notes: Buffalo's router, its Plush templates in the application layout and r.JSON, in the production environment with the worker off.
details: Buffalo's router (buffalo.App with app.GET), its render engine (render.New with Plush templates read from templates/ and wrapped in an application layout, r.HTML, whose <%= %> escapes) and r.JSON, with Env set to production and the background worker off (the shop has no jobs). Request logging is off: buffalo.RequestLogger, the variable Buffalo documents for replacing its logging middleware, is a pass-through. Only what buffalo.New sets up is used: none of the middleware a generated application adds (CSRF, parameter logger, i18n, database transaction) because the shop has no forms, database or translations. Served by net/http's server with the *buffalo.App as its handler, as app.Serve does after its setup. One process on the default Go scheduler, built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed on first use and cached by the render engine in production.
